direction: Agent autonomous exploration; manual experiments optional and separate

light.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity desktop web interface, full-screen 16:10 landscape, straight-on screenshot, no device frame, high resolution. Readable concise Simplified Chinese, implementable polished layout.
Input image 1 is a REFERENCE ONLY for a clean node-and-port experimental network visualization. Completely replace its navigation and realistic instruments. Do not preserve irrelevant content.
Product: "ChemWorld", explicitly a "虚拟实验室". The CENTRAL experience is an AGENT AUTONOMOUSLY EXPLORING: it poses questions/hypotheses, designs an experiment network, runs virtual operations, observes results, records public research notes, and decides its next experiment. The human mostly watches, optionally chooses goal/model/budget and starts or stops the run. Human manual experiment composition is an entirely separate optional extra, at most a quiet menu item "手动实验（可选）". It is NOT human–Agent collaboration. NO shared editing, human authorship badges on graph nodes, chat assistant, "交给 Agent", "一起", approval gates, mandatory confirmation steps, drag-to-edit active runtime, or collaborative cursors. Do NOT ask a human for the next action. Agent determines and revises future experiments autonomously.
Navigation ONLY "探索", "实验", "研究记录", "设置". "探索" selected. NO literature search, resource library, knowledge base, internet retrieval, compound catalog, commercial instruments, real lab control, photorealistic hardware. Use flat schematic icons for a simulated experimental network "物料 A" + "介质 B" → "混合" → "加热" → "取样" → "测量"; sample route can branch to "留样". No real chemical formulae needed.
Visible exact labels "ChemWorld", "虚拟实验室", "概念设计 · 演示数据". All content is mock virtual data; no claim of real chemical accuracy or actual model performance. Traces have axis labels and units. The current execution graph is a read-only visualization generated by Agent actions; past outcomes never get rewritten. If two graph edge types are shown, solid teal means "样品流", dashed violet means "执行依赖"; include legend and keep meanings consistent.
Show Agent as the active researcher with concise "研究目标", "当前实验", actual public action records, separate "环境观测" and "Agent 研究笔记". Notes are explicit authored hypotheses, predictions and plans, not secret chain-of-thought. No thinking transcript, neural imagery, or claimed access to unspoken reasoning. Prefer "待检验", "观测", "修订" to unjustified certainty. Completed, active and future experiments visibly distinct; future results "—" or "尚无结果". Visible bounded resource use with selected model "Model A", simulated clock distinct from wall clock. Stop/pause controls available but not visually overwhelming. Unknown time ETA omitted.
Good hierarchy, coherent layout, no generic giant KPI card grid, no lorem ipsum, no long paragraphs, no person avatars, no unrelated menus, no 3D scenes.

A1: canvas-first autonomous exploration, crisp light interface. White and cool light-grey, graphite text, restrained violet Agent identity and teal active path. Top header "Agent 自主探索", state "运行中 · 第 3 轮实验", goal "探索加热时间对虚拟环境终态的影响". A huge read-only node network occupies left 70 percent; right 30 percent is the Agent research state, not a conversation. Tiny left navigation rail only.
Network toolbar offers "适应画布" "缩放" "跟随当前操作", no add or delete buttons. Six/seven connected nodes, selected current node "测量" outlined teal with status "执行中", previous nodes "已完成"; compact parameter on heating node "8 min". Small caption "由 Agent 生成 · 实验 03". Right inspector has "Model A", "环境观测" with a small spectrum x "Wavelength (nm)" y "Absorbance (AU)", and separate "Agent 研究笔记": "假设：加热时间可能影响终态。状态：待检验。" Below, a future-plan card "下一实验草稿" with "加热时间 12 min" and "当前实验结束后由 Agent 决定".
Bottom dock is an event strip: "生成网络" → "执行操作" → "采集观测", plus exact counters "工具调用 18 / 60", "模拟时间 12 min", "墙钟 01:42". Top-right primary understated "暂停探索" and small "停止". Quiet gear menu item "手动实验（可选）". A strong clear Agent-centric page with enough space to follow the network. Corner label "A1 / Autonomous Canvas".

dark.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, UI dark theme.
The input is the APPROVED LIGHT-THEME layout for ChemWorld's autonomous Agent virtual laboratory. Create the matching DARK THEME of EXACTLY this interface. Keep ALL geometry, panel positions, graph nodes, connections, icons, text, values, sizes, spacing, controls, selected states, charts, labels and content unchanged. This is one product with two themes, not another design.
Only convert colors: the page and sidebar become deep neutral charcoal #10151c; panels #18212b; graph canvas #121b24 with a subtle cool-grey dot grid; borders #2b3947; primary text warm white #e6edf3; secondary text #a2b2c3. Preserve teal data/active sample paths, use accessible lavender-violet for Agent accents and primary buttons. Recolor charts axes, gridlines and icons for clear dark-background contrast. White input surfaces become dark opaque surfaces. Keep a restrained professional scientific application, not neon/cyberpunk. No shadows that resemble glowing holograms. No new navigation, no extra text, no rearrangement.
Keep the exact existing "Agent 自主探索", "虚拟实验室", "概念设计 · 演示数据" labels. Human manual experiments stay a quiet optional sidebar item. The Agent remains the sole autonomous explorer. Preserve the full 16:10 screenshot framing.

scope: User narrowed five variants to two aligned themes; other variants are not outstanding deliverables.
